newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey says JCI sells stake.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey says JCI sells stake.

text.p: Johnson Matthey Plc said on Friday it understood JCI Ltd had sold its 18.9 million share stake through investment bank SBC Warburg at 560p per share.
The sale boosted trading volume in the precious metal producer to more than 37.5 million shares by 0938 GMT, making it the most active stock in the London market at that point.
Johnson Matthey chief executive Gordon Thorburn told Reuters he understood the stock had been placed with a number of institutional investors.
Noting that Matthey shares had firmed following the placing, he said the market's response had been "really quite encouraging."
Matthey shares were up 5p at 569-1/2 by 0941 GMT.
